frozenPolicy.holdout: The full sealed later capture is scored as holdout; no fitting, selection, or threshold tuning occurs.

atomic.interpretation: At one timestamp, one YES ask plus the complementary NO ask (1 minus YES bid) costs 1 plus the YES spread. Sequential positive outcomes require a favorable later move and are not locked-in arbitrage.

sameTimestampCandidateAndFillEvidence.note: Visible same-time prices are not actual fills; positive sequential pairs retain first-leg directional exposure.

oneTickAdverseStress.application: Subtract one official tick from each leg’s per-share P&L; this is a sensitivity, not a new fill model or selector.

limitations: Displayed depth and sequential pairing are counterfactual; no contest orders, accepted orders, actual fills, or account data are included.
The capture is one later 73-minute window with 237 related election markets; rows and contracts are not independent samples.
A positive sequential pair reflects directional movement during the unhedged interval, not risk-free arbitrage.
One-tick adverse stress subtracts one official 0.005 tick on each leg; it is a sensitivity, not an observed execution cost.
